source_record.title: Visiting Analyst - Investments & Automation
source_record.description:
• YZR Capital is a leading HealthTech investment platform, with rapid AuM growth, backed by top-tier LPs, investing from Seed to Series B

  • Operating out of Munich, our portfolio spans Europe and the US, with investments across 11 countries

  • The team is responsible for several lighthouse transactions in the sector, such as Biorce and Scan

Tasks

  • Investments: Be fully integrated into the investment team and support transactions across all stages of the investment process, including sourcing, screening, due diligence, and writing investment memos.

  • Processes & workflow automation: Map our current processes, identify where time is lost, and build and maintain AI agents (e.g. with Claude and our CRM, data and productivity tools) that take that work off the team.

  • Thesis work: Run market deep dives in sectors relevant to our investment focus and turn them into investment theses, market maps and target lists.

  • Fundraising support: Support our Fund II fundraising, e.g. by mapping the LP landscape in specific geographies and keeping our LP pipeline up to date.

  • Fund admin & events: Support fund administration, and help organise our events.

Requirements

  • Entrepreneurial, analytical and curious mindset

  • Enthusiasm for new business models in HealthTech / Techbio and for the healthcare system as a whole

  • Excellent academic performance and/or outstanding extracurricular activities; enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor's or Master's programme (business, economics, engineering, computer science, or similar)

  • Previous practical experience in a start-up, strategy consulting, investment banking, venture capital or private equity

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools and workflow automation: you have used LLMs (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) and tools like n8n, or Zapier

  • Strong MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Available full-time for 3 months from February 2027, on-site in Munich

Successful applicants will support a dynamic team, and gain close insights into the operations of a VC fund.

We are looking forward to your application!
